versions.changelog:
Initial release: Converts vague feature ideas into actionable, decision-focused design briefs for team approval and downstream implementation.

- Guides through a structured process to clarify intent, scope, decisions, interface details, and constraints.
- Ensures all design decisions include rationale and cost if wrong; records both accepted and rejected alternatives.
- Avoids duplication by resuming existing briefs for the same subject.
- Tight workflow: code-based precedent checks, user interviews only when needed, and clear approval/change/drop phases.
- Outputs comprehensive briefs as Markdown files for use by implementation and planning tools.
